messages:
mike: Quick heads-up: scheduling a narrow-wave at 05:00 UTC to roll runtime 2.14.1 + router header rename. Plan: router+runtime canary 5% then api/console to 10%. Pin 30m.
anya: prefer router+runtime canary only first, agree on 5% then monitor 6m. No DB changes right?
mike: No DB changes. It's header key rename + small KV cache tweak.
tim: paste the deploy command so I can queue it.
mike: Command:
```
deploy-bot start-wave --id=narrow-13 --components=router,runtime,api,console --seq=router,runtime -> api,console --pin=30m --traffic=5/10
```
deploy-bot: queued narrow-13 for 05:00 UTC. Notifying oncall.
sre-bot: Preflight checks ok. Monitoring rules: router_header_errors, svc_5xx_rate, p90_latency. Alerts set.
deploy-bot: starting canary phase (router,runtime) 5% -> monitoring 6m.
anya: Canary live. watching logs.
tim: seeing a header_parse NPE in api at t+2m, count=1. stack points to HeaderParser line 84.
anya: Recommend abort and rollback; this looks like empty header value edge-case.
mike: Agreed. aborting now.
deploy-bot: abort received. initiating rollback to previous versions.
deploy-bot: rollback complete. Pins cleared for narrow-13.
sre-bot: Post-rollback: run full smoke suite and keep header parser debug logs for 1h.
mike: Thanks team. I'll open a follow-up INF ticket to add empty/null guard and unit tests, then re-run router+runtime canary only after fixes.
